review: Rendered outputs visually inspected. Shortened cluster titles and wrapped sequence messages to avoid truncation and excessive width. Removed the overview cluster header to prevent an incoming edge crossing its label. Status is carried in text as well as color.
syntax_failure: The first sequence render rejected an unescaped semicolon in a message; original log retained. The text was corrected, not the parser or package.

source_guidance.demonstrates: Flowcharts support nodes, directed edges, subgraphs and class styles. Current docs also advertise newer/beta types.
source_guidance.rules_out: Does not prove GitHub supports all current/beta features.
source_guidance.action: Use stable flowchart and sequence forms in the existing installed renderer.

source_guidance.demonstrates: Accessible titles and descriptions accompany diagrams.
source_guidance.action: Each new diagram includes accTitle and accDescr.

source_guidance.demonstrates: GitHub renders fenced Mermaid and advises checking its actual renderer version.
source_guidance.rules_out: Latest upstream documentation is not proof of hosted renderer parity.
source_guidance.action: No speculative beta syntax or global upgrade; local two-theme verification. Actual hosted visual acceptance is not asserted.
